sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of five consecutive wins, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday. The visitors will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the league with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches. This is a straightforward opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a fixture between two mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to build on their recent draw. Title-race contenders AFC Bridgnorth, currently third on 19 points, travel to Eccleshall, who have won three of their last five despite a recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) are at home to Wednesfield Community, while fellow promotion-chasing sides Bilston Town and Barnton face Foley Meir and Shawbury United respectively. In the basement battle, struggling sides Widnes Town host Brereton Social, Telford Town visit Cheadle Heath Nomads (both winless in multiple games), and Crewe entertain Allscott Heath. Market Drayton Town make the trip to New Mills in a clash between sides in the lower half seeking momentum.
